_comment_mode: free = only what a free API key sustains (DuckDuckGo instead of grounded search, lite model, no continuous vision). paid = everything on.
_comment_location: Overrides everything else for the local news briefing. 'City' or 'City, Region'. Leave empty to use a city stored in memory, then IP geolocation.
_comment_ip_geolocation: Set false to never look up your location by IP. Skipped anyway whenever a city is already known from 'location' above or from long-term memory.
_comment_voice: Prebuilt Live API voice. 30 are available and you can audition them all in AI Studio. Character per Google's docs: Charon=Informative (default), Gacrux=Mature, Schedar=Even, Algieba=Smooth, Sulafat=Warm, Achird=Friendly, Enceladus=Breathy, Zubenelgenubi=Casual, Kore=Firm, Puck=Upbeat.
_comment_barge_in: false (default): talking over JARVIS never interrupts him, and the mic is muted while he speaks so his own voice is not transcribed as yours. Only the Interrupt button stops him. true: speech interrupts him, tuned by the three settings below.
_comment_barge_in_tuning: Only used when barge_in is true. rms = absolute floor below which nothing counts as speech; blocks = how many consecutive 64ms blocks must be loud; margin = how far above the measured speaker bleed speech has to sit. Raise them if he interrupts himself, lower them if he is hard to interrupt.
